product_one_liner.value: Forwood provides safety and risk-management software, including critical-risk tools designed to help organizations in high-risk industries such as mining, construction, and utilities prevent serious injuries and fatalities.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation/footer does not present a pricing page or public plans; the contact page is a get-in-touch/contact page.

eng_blog.notes: The index is primarily safety, critical-risk, and product/marketing content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored product-building posts.

public_docs.notes: The public help center includes multiple articles and collections, including a Forwood Users collection listing four articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings listed are sales and critical-risk/industry specialist roles; none has an AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Forwood says its FAST application uses QuickSight Q, which uses machine learning for natural-language data queries; this identifies the provider/tool, not a separate foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page lists ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2; the company's compliance article specifies SOC 2 Type 2.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists the latest deal as Later Stage VC on 2023-10-31; the round amount is not stated.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed funding deal is dated 2023-10, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09; Macquarie also describes its investment as occurring in 2022.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive - Enterprise SaaS Sales posting is listed with an application option.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest identified major product release in the company’s news history is Safety+ 2.0, published 2025-01-21, before the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A profile lists Muralidhar Siddavatam as Head of Innovation & CTO at Forwood Safety through December 2025, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A sales posting refers generically to maintaining information in “the CRM,” but names no CRM or sales/marketing platform.
